detail.longDescription: Hello, Fediverse! I'm David, from Brazil 🇧🇷. I'm a Linux enthusiast and kernel contributor, currently working mostly around HFS/filesystems. I also develop games and spend an unreasonable amount of time messing with computers. Here I'll probably talk about Linux, kernel development, gamedev, games and whatever technical rabbit hole I fall into next. # Linux # LinuxKernel # OpenSource # GameDev # Gaming
